name: HUD — Picture of Subsidized Households, 2024 and 2025 (State and U.S.)
organization: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, Office of Policy Development and Research (HUD USER)
routing: Chronicle staging only (data/ledger/us_admin_outturns.jsonl), per the 2026-08-02 boundary ruling (issue #6): administrative outturns are calibration material, never scorecard claims.
method: HUD program records: units under contract for federal subsidy and available for occupancy; household characteristics from tenant reports (Forms 50058 and 50059) received as of December, with effective dates over the prior 18 months. Average HUD expenditure per unit-month includes operating subsidy and capital cost for public housing, and the housing assistance payment (plus an administrative fee for tenant-based vouchers and Moderate Rehabilitation) otherwise.
geographies: U.S., 50 States, DC, territories, and HUD's 'XX Missing' bucket
coverage_note: Program-level rows plus the voucher tenant-/project-based splits; the 2025 MTW/non-MTW administrative splits are dropped with a tally. Distributional shares (income brackets, family type, age, race, disability, bedrooms, tract context) stay in raw/ unstaged.
vintage_note: The 2024 files have 74 columns (no occupied-unit count); the 2025 files have 88 and add the 811 PRA program and sub-program splits.
